title: ticfac init and ticfac doctor: a repo is ready to run in one step, and says what is missing
description: ticfac init asks a few questions (local, cloud or both; claude or pi; which model) and writes .tick/runners.toml, the optional runners.local.toml / runners.cloud.toml, and a .tick/config.md with the close-out rule, with the gate guessed from the repo (go test, pnpm test, make test...) and shown for confirmation. It refuses to overwrite. ticfac doctor checks what a run needs: tk version, herdr socket, gh auth, git identity, and for cloud docker + wrangler + the factory's status, each with the fix command.
acceptance_criteria: init on a fresh repo writes files that validate and run an epic end to end; init refuses to overwrite; doctor reports each missing prerequisite with its fix; tests cover a Go repo, a Node repo and a repo with neither
